summary: Lemhi County lookout: 1930s log cabin, 1940 L-4 cab, abandoned 1950, burned in 2000; no source describes what remains at the site.

facts.status_note: Burned in 2000; no source describes what remains at the site.

events.note: Log cabin; sources date it only to the 1930s
Missing a window and two shutters; winds had gotten out of hand, per a Recorder Herald item quoted by Forest Lookouts

evidence.supports: log cabin in the 1930s, L-4 cab in 1940, abandoned 1950, burned 2000

winds got out of control; window and shutters missing

notes_for_editor: Three sources agree on the 1930s cabin, 1940 L-4 cab, 1950 abandonment and 2000 burning. The record's 2000 event reads 'destroyed'; all three sources say burned, so the research file uses 'burned'. This is a label choice, so no correction is written. The 'abandoned' staffing status and 'hike-in' (drive_up false) rest on one line each. No source describes the site today. A search snippet from the Lewiston Tribune (page returned 403, not readable here) names the Hot Springs Lookout among structures lost in the Clear Creek fire; it is not cited because the page could not be read, and the fire is not named in the story. Worth checking. Used 2 searches and about 4 page reads. Checked 2026-10-10: the wind sentence now paraphrases the Recorder Herald item without implying a cause. The Lewiston Tribune snippet is still unverified and is not in the story.
